title: Retain source-failure and search context in empty Urgent results
outcome: An empty Urgent view retains the panel's incomplete-source and search-result context.
acceptance: When readable rows are empty because a source failed, Urgent explicitly identifies the incomplete view.
When a search has no results, Urgent retains search-specific context while still showing its short empty state when rows exist but none are urgent.
Behavioral tests cover source failure and search no-match in Urgent.
